body.message:
Unfortunately, an AED 5,500 rate will not be possible.

We can offer you a final rate of AED 6,050 for your first extension of 30 nights. After that, the rates will be as follows:

Second extension: AED 6,500 for 30 nights
Third extension: AED 7,500 for 30 nights

If this works for you, please let us know, and we will be happy to assist you with the extension process accordingly.

Thank you.
